patch.summary: Is LeadIQ worth it? Sales intelligence platform centered on Chrome and LinkedIn contact capture, Universal Credits, and deep CRM sync — with a free credit tier, Pro from list price, and Enterprise packaging, plus Scribe AI assistance.. Strong when SDR teams that capture contacts from LinkedIn/Chrome and sync straight into CRM. Weak when Pro starts at list price — higher entry than many SMB contact tools.

sections.heading: LeadIQ: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs contact data and SDR teams that capture contacts from LinkedIn/Chrome and sync straight into CRM holds. Counter-signal: Walk when Pro starts at list price — higher entry than many SMB contact tools would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Pro, Enterprise.

sections.heading: Who LeadIQ is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose LeadIQ when Chrome/LinkedIn capture plus excellent CRM sync (and Scribe AI assist) are the primary jobs..

Avoid if: Compare Lusha for enrichment-first SMB data, Apollo for data+sequences, LinkedIn Sales Navigator for graph prospecting, and Seamless.AI for high-volume contact search..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Lusha on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: LeadIQ price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
Prove one real workflow on the documented free/trial path before arguing for Pro.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
